why_28Apr_not_26Apr: The terminal numbers robustly cross on 26 Apr; roughly 36-48 hours are retained for final artillery/engineer movement from dispersed holding areas, issue of H-hour orders, traffic sequencing and first-wave air preparation. No extra week is purchased merely for a round calendar date.
western_air_pressure_relation: The existing late-April Chengdu/Matterhorn pressure is retained as a real western allocation tax. It may complicate Allied air allocation, but is not promoted into a fictional perfect diversion or required cause of Hunan success.
phase_B: Hengyang remains conditional on post-Changsha logistics/enemy response.
